== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Black [[dragons]] were once the dominant rulers of their continent, possessing power that far exceeded that of the [[Akura clan|Akura family]] and the [[Gold dragons|gold dragons]], who served as their subordinates. While they are now a scattered people with an almost entirely eradicated bloodline and forgotten [[Authority|authority]], their historical legacy remains significant. They are characterized by a deep connection to destruction and the [[Path of Black Flame]], possessing a primal and savage form of [[madra]] that is highly compatible with human practitioners of that path. Physically, they are described as massive, serpentine beings with large wings, claws, and eyes featuring dark voids with fiery rings. Their breath is a potent tool capable of creating intense conflagrations of black and red fire that can devour stone. Despite their destructive reputation, they were known to possess a sense of pride and honor that prevented them from behaving shamefully, such as bullying the young or slaughtering villages. Today, their influence persists through relics, willpower trials, and dragon-[[Remnants]] found across the continent, as well as through descendants like [[Orthos]].}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|A member of [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]]'s team, the black dragon possesses a long, snake-like body equipped with massive claws and two huge wings. Its eyes resemble those of [[Orthos]], appearing as solid darkness containing two fiery rings. This creature radiates the power of destruction and is capable of breathing a bar of darkness filled with red sparks.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The black [[dragons]] serve as the proud kings of the continent. For hundreds of years, a [[Herald Remnant]] belonging to one of these [[dragons]] remained frozen in time within a castle. Eventually, a black dragon with shimmering red [[scales]] erupted from the basement of [[Shatterspine Castle]], where other black [[dragons]] were also present. During these events, [[dream madra]] began to take control of the [[dragons]] residing in the castle.}}
